Continuation note, arrow-linked to the facing page.

page_annotations: The upper half of the page is blank apart from the folio number; faint ruled show-through was judged not to be text.

The strip right of the gutter (x>3130) shows a fragment of facing fol. 7: shelfmarks with ticks (c. 390, c. 368, b. 74, d. 944, d. 117, d. 312, e 72, d. 328, ff. 1-3, d. 392, d. 397, d. 1123, c. 181, d. 244). These are not transcribed as target records.
Binding thread runs down the gutter, with a knot at about y 2700. Small ink specks at about (460, 3000) are not text.
unresolved_relationships: The short dashes just right of the gutter thread may belong either to this page's arrows or to the facing page.
All attachments to fol. 7 rows are positional (arrows or line alignment), not explicit.

coverage.finding: Folio number '6' with superscript 'b', top left at about (360,300)–(440,400). The record is accurate.

An ink line at y≈2440 reads '4ff. pp. 71-74, foll. by 3ff., pp. 75-77, from Śivarahasya(?).' A left arrow at about x 3054–3194, y 2443 points toward fol. 7 row c. 390. The punctuation after '4ff.' is cramped. The record is acceptable.

The pencil line is confirmed. The word between 'Oṁ' and 'adyetyādi' is overwritten or blotted and is correctly left illegible. The anusvāra form looks like m with a dot above, but this is uncertain and already flagged. A faint pencil hooked mark sits at about (3030,2560).

The indented ink line ending 'Cf. Oxf. Cat. 76, adhy. 92.' is confirmed. No arrow is visible on the target page. The '.92.' visible at the left edge of the fol. 7 image is this same line seen across the spread, not separate text.
The line starting mid-page, 'ff.1-16, S.1824, portions of text in I.O. 5570', is confirmed. The spacing is compressed in the source. The arrow is at about x 2994–3084, y 2908.

The two-line note is confirmed, with interlinear '2' and '1'. The arrow is at about x 2894–3049, y 4236. The '68,' plus arrow is also visible at the left edge of the fol. 7 image at the c. 181 row, which confirms alignment only. The first title word remains uncertain. The '8' of '68' appears overwritten.

unresolved.issue: The first title word is read as 'Mucuṇṭīkā' but the letter forms are ambiguous. It should not be normalized from knowledge of the facing-page Anargharāghava entry.
The overwritten pencil word before 'adyetyādi' is unread. The anusvāra notation (ṃ vs ṁ) is uncertain.
There is a small faint mark near the top edge close to the gutter (about x 3030, y 290). It is probably a paper mark or show-through, not text, but this is unconfirmed.
Short dashes just right of the gutter thread may be arrow tails crossing the gutter or facing-page marks. All attachments to fol. 7 rows are positional only.
unresolved.next_check: Compare with native fol. 7 left strip.

review.boundary_review: The strip right of the gutter thread (x>~3130) belongs to facing fol. 7: shelfmarks with ticks (c. 390 through d. 244). It is correctly not transcribed. The binding thread, the knot at y≈2700, and the black blob at the top right (facing-page edge) are physical features. The relationships to fol. 7 rows remain probable and positional.

region_review.top: Only the folio number; faint ruled show-through and a tiny mark near the gutter top; no text.
region_review.middle: Blocks b002–b005 around y 2400–2950; nothing else besides ink specks near (460,3000) and scattered dots.
region_review.bottom: b006 at y≈4200–4400; below it only stray specks to the page edge; no bottom note.
region_review.right_margin: Arrows near the gutter for b002, b003 (pencil) and b005, plus the arrow at the end of b006 line 1; beyond the gutter lies the facing-page fragment.
region_review.interlinear: Numerals '2' and '1' above b006 line 1; no other interlinear additions found.
